content: W3C WCAG 2.2 AA requires 4.5:1 normal text contrast (without rounding), 3:1 contrast for meaningful UI components/states against adjacent colors, visible persistent keyboard focus, focus not entirely obscured, and reflow without two-dimensional scrolling at 320 CSS px except content needing a two-dimensional layout. The official Reflow understanding document explicitly identifies side-by-side code/document change review as a valid locally horizontally scrolling two-column comparison and recommends limiting the exception to that section.
